name: Deep Space Milky Way
description: Full-area canvas night sky with twinkling colored stars, a dense procedural Milky Way band built from thousands of dots and soft star clusters, and occasional shooting stars over a radial gradient.
contents: Static Milky Way canvas drawn once per resize
Animated canvas with twinkling stars and shooting stars
behavior: Stars twinkle by cycling through a precomputed random array each frame
Shooting stars spawn randomly near the top and fade in and out with a gradient trail
Both canvases resize to the window and the sky is redrawn on window resize
editableByProps: Star count, size, twinkle strength and shooting star frequency and colors
Milky Way density, cluster count and tilt angle

needsCodeEdit.change: Change Milky Way hue range or cluster size
Change shooting star speed, length or lifespan

fixed: Root is absolutely positioned to fill its nearest positioned parent and sizes canvases from the window dimensions
Window resize listener redraws the sky and is removed on unmount
